details.name: MOB.712_AssetLookup_System_Create
details.message:
`MOB.712` **Create a System from an asset's `System` field** — proved over `/graphql`.
- On the first `DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE` row in Asset Lookup (a critical guard requires its `Name` to be
  `DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE <8 digits>` before anything is typed) — never a fixture.
- `System` is hidden by default (`display: false`), so it is ticked in the column picker; the
  selection persists to localStorage, so it is recorded first and unticked `always`.
- Types `DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE <RUNID>` into the per-field `System` lookup and clicks `+ Create '…'`:
  `onCreate` fires CREATE_SYSTEM and UPDATE_ASSET without awaiting either and closes the modal,
  so the modal and the transient `System updated` toast prove nothing (trap 6).
- ⭐ **Server proof**: exactly one System carries the typed name, and the asset's `systemId` is
  that System by id and name.
- ⚠️ **LEAVES RESIDUE**: one System per run (mobile cannot delete one), and the marker asset's
  `systemId` points at the newest.

Focus the search input
Select any persisted query first (typeText APPENDS — trap 17)
Search for "DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE"
Submit the search (Enter — there is no search button)
RESULT GUARD: a "DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE" row rendered (MOB.600 residue)

steps.name: The edit modal opened on the System lookup (`#systemId`)
Focus the System lookup
Select any current System name (typeText APPENDS — trap 17)
Type a new System name "DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE {{ RUNID }}"
The lookup holds `DD SYNTHETIC MOBILE <8 digits>`; record it (the JS never reads RUNID)
The dropdown offers exactly ONE option `+ Create '<that name>'` (`ListFilter`, `noMatch`)
Click `+ Create` — `onCreate`: CREATE_SYSTEM, then UPDATE_ASSET systemId
Brief wait for the toast
`System updated` toast (optional: transient — UPDATE_ASSET's `update()`)
The System lookup's modal is gone and the row is still expanded (it closes whatever the server says — not proof)
⭐ SERVER: exactly ONE System carries the typed name (CREATE_SYSTEM stored it, once)
Remove the server read's sessionStorage keys
⭐ SERVER: the asset's `systemId` IS that System — same id, same name (UPDATE_ASSET)
Remove the server read's sessionStorage keys
Close anything still open (optional)
No System lookup modal is left open, and the marker row is still on the page
Open the General Info column picker (`table-columns`)
